notes:
ROW QUESTION (brief section 6). The Cliopatria row 'Abbasid Caliphate' (750-1259, 37 shapes) is reviewed here as the Abbasid state alone; cliopatria_names holds only that Name. 'Buyid Dynasty' (936-1055) and 'Abbasid Caliphate/Buyid Dynasty' (947-969, SeshatID ir_buyid_confederation) share Wikidata Q12536 with it, but they are the Buyid state, a different state (own founding 934, own capitals Shiraz, Ray and Baghdad): the Buyid dossier from me-08-c (polities/buyid-dynasty.json) already adopts the 947-969 slash row's shape as its own keyframe and records the 934 and 945 steps against abbasid-caliphate, which agree with this ledger. The slash row's shape (735,812 km2, Iraq and Iran) is therefore not reviewed here.

WHAT CLIOPATRIA'S ABBASID ROW IS. (1) 750-898: the whole caliphate drawn solid, including autonomous governors and dynasties (Tahirids, Samanids, Aghlabids in the 800 hole, Tulunids). (2) 947-969: the shape is the Ikhshidid domain (Egypt 91%, Syria 52%, the Hejaz, Mecca, Damascus) and contains no Baghdad (0%); the caliph's Baghdad is in the slash row. Verdicts adjust and add a Baghdad core. (3) 970-1201: no shape; new keyframes give the Baghdad core (970-1135) and the Basra-to-Mosul state of al-Muqtafi and al-Nasir (1136-1201, Cliopatria's own 1202 shape; moved from 1160 to 1136 by fx-36 with the Seljuk dossier's loss). Cliopatria's Great Seljuk row still covers Baghdad and Basra in 1190, so the Seljuk and Abbasid shapes overlap in 1136-1201. (4) 1202-1259: 0.17 M km2 (Baghdad, Kufa, Samarra, Basra); ends in 1258, not 1259.

MODEL OF CONTROL. Direct land is the shape; autonomous governors and dynasties that formally acknowledged the caliph are vassal_start / vassal_end events, following the group's allegiance-tint model: Aghlabids 800-909, Samanids 819-999, Tahirids 821-873, Tulunids 873/878-905, Ikhshidids 935/944-969, Hamdanids 929-947 (reading), Ziyadids 866-946 (Cliopatria relation), Ayyubids 1202-1250, Rum 1202-1249, Mamluk Dynasty 1210-1258 (Cliopatria's 'Delhi Sultanate' relation row, an umbrella; the events use the Mamluk Dynasty shape). The Saffarids, Buyids, Qarmatians, Zaydi Alids and Zanj are not vassals: they are losses. The Saffarid recognition 'as governor of Sistan, Fars and Kerman' is undated on the page and is not written as a vassal event.

THE ZANJ. The Zanj Rebellion page shows a state-like hold (taxes, coinage, a capital at al-Mukhtarah, 869-883). I wrote a type-rebel dossier for it (zanj-rebellion, from that one page) because the Abbasid ledger needs a counterpart; me-08-x may replace it with a fuller one.
